## Historical audit — S0301

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v3/results/historical_r1_C2_start/development/commons_92056365/1/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to this file’s JSONL lines and supplied character ranges. Only chunk 1 of 2 is visible; neither the reference nor rendered images are independently visible to this audit.

| Evidence | Observed operation or result |
|---|---|
| Goal: H `model_request`, line 1 [0,11551) | Reconstruct one indoor RGB view with separate editable geometry, matching camera, framing, colors, placement and materials. The student’s inventory interprets it as a restaurant; that interpretation is not independent image verification. |
| First build: H `model_response` and `execute`, lines 3 [0,8870), 4 [0,8589) | Code creates multiple architectural, booth, table, chair, pendant and plant assets. Named child parts include seats, backs, pedestals, lamp cords and leaves. It uses color palettes and modeled floor/ceiling joints, not image textures; chair facing and camera are explicitly specified. Hierarchy is evidence of emitted parts, not proof of physical connection or correct pose. |
| First validation: `build_completed`, `render_completed`, `execution_result`, lines 6 [0,1655), 8 [0,1644), 9 [0,38503) | Build and render return zero; `ok: true` and a saved image are reported. Step 1 is selected (line 10 [0,59)). This establishes technical execution, not visual correctness. |
| Autonomous revision: H `model_request` and `model_response`, lines 11 [0,59338), 13 [0,11069) | The first render was supplied back to H. H reported cropped ceiling, small/low furniture, gray-looking windows, flat lamp and sparse plant. These are student diagnoses, not independently checked findings. The executed revision moves the camera forward/lower, extends architecture, changes window emission and lighting, and adds denser and rear foliage (line 14 [0,10787)). |
| Second validation and revision: lines 16 [0,1655), 18 [0,1642), 19 [0,54599), 20 [0,59), 23 [0,10258), 24 [0,9976) | Step 2 builds and renders successfully and is selected. After its image was supplied, H reported a small pendant, off-frame palm, missing foreground tabletop, incorrect seam direction and window corner. Step 3 code repositions objects, changes ceiling seams and view direction. |
| Latest visible status: `build_completed`, `render_completed`, lines 26 [0,1653), 28 [0,1642) | Step 3 build and render both complete with return code 0. No subsequent selection, image review or final submission is visible in this chunk. |

**Teacher input and exploration.** No teacher message, teacher detection, diagnosis, proposed update or adoption is visible here. The system’s general instructions and runner’s image-feedback prompts are actual inputs, but are not evidence of a separate teacher intervention. H independently produced and revised programs from supplied renders; the session logs report no tool calls within its model sessions (lines 2, 12 and 22).

**Outcome and uncertainty.** The visible outcome is successful execution of three builds and renders, with semantic reconstruction quality and final outcome **unknown**—not a demonstrated algorithm failure, empty patch, interruption or verified scene success. Whether the revisions improved framing, materials, connections, object coverage or lighting remains unresolved without viewing the images. The student’s scene-specific discrepancy claims are hypotheses; the transferable lesson is to distinguish render completion and editable part naming from visual and geometric verification.
